title: Garba Steps For Beginners | Navaratri Garba Dance Songs | Garba Dance Steps Video

method.teacher_system: The teachers introduce the session, break down each garba step by demonstrating footwork and arm movements separately before combining them, and then practice the full sequence to music.

practices.what: Demonstrate leg movement step by step for beginners.
Introduce hand movements separately to match the leg steps.
Perform the steps together with music.
Break down a new leg movement step by step.
Practice the new sequence along with music.
Teach a new footwork pattern slowly.
Execute the third set of steps with music.
Explain and demonstrate the next leg and dipping movement.
Do the fourth set of movements to music.
Demonstrate the final leg and arm choreography slowly.
Perform the final combined choreography with music.

moments.says: The teacher greets the viewers and introduces herself and her co-instructor before inviting everyone to learn new garba steps.

struggles.theme: Feeling unable to learn by just watching videos
Garba seeming difficult for ballet dancers

clicked.theme: Hand and leg movements taught separately and repeatedly
Steps are very easy and well explained
Systematic and easy to remember choreography

requests.theme: Ask to do all steps together on music
Request to teach specific song steps like Rangillo Maro Dholna

meant.theme: Helped with school and college navratri performances

method.limits: The video does not include verbal audio instructions during demonstrations, relying entirely on visual modeling and counting.
